The key pieces of information are the instruction to wear a scarf (Evidence 3), the absence of a scarf in the Crime Photo (Evidence 4), the presence of a scarf in the Witness's Photo (Evidence 6), and the testimony about the scarf falling off (Testimony 4). The spatial reasoning involves understanding the sequence of events and the state of the victim (wearing a scarf or not) at different times.
